description: Get your live open positions across connected exchanges (MEXC, Binance, Lighter) and Hyperliquid perps. Shows entry price, mark price, unrealized PnL, leverage, margin, and liquidation price for each position. MEXC / Binance / Lighter need exchange API keys — add them via /exchange_apis in the Asrai Telegram bot. Hyperliquid needs no keys: it reads the wallet the user trades with on asrai.me/perps (read-only). Use when asked: 'show my positions', 'what am I trading', 'my open trades', 'my PnL', 'my exchange positions'.
name: positions
title: Open trade positions
